items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Rock, Daniel' as a hit for Sister Thorpe. The interviewee does not mention Daniel, nor does he confirm any personal or professional interaction with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, they do-call them singles now --

they were called two-sided records then. We had "Shout Sister Shout, Trouble In Mind, with Sister Thorpe; "Rock, Daniel," which was a big hit for her, and "Let Me Off Uptown," "Savoy," "Little John Special."
Oh, "Little John Special" -- that was a big hit, wasn't it?
